title: spec: the retired connector.webhooks error says a top-level webhook "is materialized into sys_webhook", contradicting ADR-0131 D2
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVkGJizGH7raJHhAvL

Filing gate: ① a product defect (an author-facing error message that prescribes a false model), found by a QA run (off-clause probe, RUNNER rule 8).

## Reproduction
1. Copy `examples/app-showcase` to a scratch directory. In `src/system/connectors/index.ts`, add `webhooks: [{url:'http://x/c', events:['create']}] as any` to `showcase_status_api`.
2. Run `objectstack compile` in the copy. It exits 2, as it should.
3. Expected: the prescription describes the current model, in which a declared top-level webhook is read from the metadata registry and writes no `sys_webhook` row (ADR-0131 D2).
4. Actual: the message says "…declare it in the stack's top-level `webhooks:` collection, which is materialized into `sys_webhook` and delivered on record events…".

## Mechanism
`packages/spec/src/integration/connector.zod.ts` ~L654 (`WEBHOOKS_RETIRED`) still carries the pre-ADR-0131 wording. `packages/spec/src/automation/webhook.zod.ts` L61–66 states the opposite: "no `sys_webhook` row is written for it". On a live boot, a declared webhook wrote 0 `sys_webhook` rows (QA run below, webhook-lifecycle A0). An author following the message then looks for a row that never appears.
